arguments.need: I want my AI coding assistant to be able to look up things on Iranian websites for me, like comparing a product's price across local shops, finding cheap domestic flights, or checking which doctors have open appointment slots. Prices should come back in Toman, not a mix of Rial and Toman. It has to plug into Claude or Cursor as a tool server, and I don't want to create accounts or get API keys for each site. Free and open source, please.
